tests.message: [disclosure_freshness:TR-09, TB-1, RC-03] race/standings data from a snapshot (or no tool) is never disclosed as latest-available: 'Qualifying for the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit starts on Saturday, October 3rd, at 10 AM for you in Vienna.'; [judge] NOT MET: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times. — The agent provided inaccurate information by stating the Bahrain Grand Prix takes place at the Sepang International Circuit (which are two different locations). Furthermore, while the agent provided the correct time for Vienna (10 AM), the response failed to actually provide the converted time for Edinburgh, only mentioning the relative offset in a way that suggests a manual calculation rather than accurate scheduling data. Finally, the agent's response was completely disconnected from the actual tool response data provided by the API.
